# Security Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that security requirements, controls, and disclosed limitations are complete and testable
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Input, Destinations, and Abuse

- [ ] CHK001 - Are allowed schemes, length, normalization, host, and user-information rules defined with a rejection reason per class? [Completeness, Spec FR-003..FR-005, DEC-008, PA-006, PA-007, ADR-027] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are internal, loopback, private, and self-referencing destinations defined with the address-form variants? [Coverage, Spec FR-005, Data Model §2.4] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are DNS rebinding and absent reputation checking disclosed as limitations rather than implied covered? [Assumption, Security R-18, R-19, ADR-027] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are abuse cases AB-01..AB-12 each given a control and a test requirement? [Completeness, Security §3.4] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are rate-limit dimensions, thresholds, trusted-proxy rule, and exceeded behavior defined, including token-discard evasion? [Clarity, Spec FR-022, PVT-006, PA-001, DEC-057] [M, G0]

## Authentication, Authorization, and Privacy

- [ ] CHK006 - Are authentication assumptions documented for both planes with trade-offs (anonymous shortener, bearer credentials, loopback, no TLS)? [Completeness, Spec DEC-010, Security §3.6, T-1] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is authorization defined per operation, including creator-only count reads with identical 404 non-disclosure? [Coverage, Spec DEC-049, ADR-024] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is shared identity behind one address disclosed with its consequences? [Assumption, Spec LIM-004, DEC-061] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are privacy rules defined (no raw addresses, approved analytics fields, retention, IP-hash secret)? [Completeness, Spec FR-013, ASM-016, POL-PRV-001] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is least privilege defined for database roles and credentials (DML-only application role, bootstrap role only for migrate)? [Coverage, Spec DEC-095, DEC-113, ADR-003] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are secure defaults defined, with a startup refusal for unsafe settings? [Completeness, Security §5] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the Redis security posture defined (password, loopback, ephemeral, poisoning controls)? [Coverage, ADR-015, Security TH-14] [M, G0]

## Secrets, Supply Chain, and Integrity

- [ ] CHK013 - Are secret generation, storage, rotation, and prohibited locations defined, with a detection and a seeded negative control? [Measurability, Security §4.3, POL-SEC-002] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Do the secret and privacy rules cover evidence committed to GitHub? [Coverage, Spec DEC-112, Security §4.3] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are dependency controls defined (allow-list, lock integrity, audit, license check), with unresolved high or critical findings blocking? [Measurability, Spec DEC-054, POL-DEP-001, POL-LIC-001, POL-SEC-005] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "unresolved" finding defined as neither remediated nor covered by an approved exception? [Clarity, Spec DEC-054] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is audit integrity defined (append-only, hash chain, verification, safe-stop on failure) with the superuser-rewrite residual risk disclosed? [Completeness, Spec FR-130, ADR-006, Security R-09] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is a security-failure response defined (audit chain break, suspected credential leak, rotation)? [Gap, Security §4.3, R-10] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does each threat TH-01..TH-16 map to a requirement or test, with none unowned? [Traceability, Security §4.2] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are signed audit events, reputation checks, and OpenTelemetry labelled backlog? [Coverage, Plan §6.1] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
